title: Zesty Crunchy Egyptian Bulgur Pilaf
description: A bright, malty bulgur pilaf with a lemony crunch, perfect for a brunch that feels like a sunny Egyptian morning.

ingredients.name: Raw blanched almonds, toasted
ingredients.notes: blanch in boiling water 30 sec, then dry

instructions: Rinse the bulgur under cold water until the runoff runs clear.
In a medium pot, bring the vegetable broth and 1 tablespoon of olive oil to a boil.
Add the bulgur, reduce heat, cover, and simmer until the liquid is absorbed and the bulgur is tender, about 12 minutes.
While the bulgur cooks, toast the blanched almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 3 minutes, then set aside.
In the same skillet, heat the remaining tablespoon of olive oil and sauté the diced onion and minced garlic until translucent, about 4 to 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, and cooked bulgur, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Fold in the lemon zest, lemon juice, toasted almonds, and chopped parsley, mixing until everything is evenly coated.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with extra parsley or lemon wedges if desired.
